questions.question: Who informs payroll, and how? Does the report go to payroll directly when it is submitted, or does HR receive it and pass it on? 'Payroll is informed' (AC-03.1.1) can't be tested until we know who must have received what. This also decides whether HR has to check the report before payroll sees it.

AC-03.1.2 says only that payroll receives the new country. Payroll also has to know which employee moved. Which details identify the employee in the information payroll gets (name, staff number, etc.)? This is separate from OQ-06, which covers the valid-from date and the full address.

Is there a deadline for informing payroll? Payslips go out on the 25th (FEAT-02), and moves can be reported up to three months late or with a future date. Must payroll be told immediately, before a certain payroll run, or by some other deadline?

What happens when an employee who lives abroad moves back to Switzerland? The rule looks only at the new country, so payroll would not be told. Yet source tax may then stop or change. Should payroll be told whenever the country of residence changes, or only when the new country is not Switzerland?

Should payroll be told about a move from one foreign country to another (e.g. Germany to France)? The rule as written says yes. Please confirm this is intended and not just a side effect of how the rule is worded.
If a reported move abroad is later corrected (e.g. a different country) or withdrawn, must payroll be told about the correction or withdrawal?

How does this interact with FEAT-02? If the valid-from date is more than three months in the past and the report is rejected or sent to HR (OQ-05), is payroll still informed of the move abroad? If yes, when?

The business rule says payroll 'does not need to be informed' of moves within Switzerland. US-03.2 / AC-03.2.1 say payroll 'is not informed' (a prohibition, for data minimisation). Which applies? For example, is it acceptable if payroll can see moves within Switzerland in shared master data?
Should the employee be told that their move abroad will be passed on to payroll, and should HR or the employee get confirmation that payroll was informed?
Do any countries other than Switzerland need special handling for source tax (e.g. Liechtenstein), or does every country other than Switzerland trigger the payroll notice the same way?
